ownership: A conflated global places theme assembled from multiple named providers and published by Overture Maps Foundation
catalog_license: Places records carry source-specific CDLA-Permissive-2.0, Apache-2.0, or CC0-1.0 terms
source_access: Public anonymous read-only STAC metadata and release-scoped GeoParquet assets on Overture's AWS bucket
allowed_use: read-only STAC release discovery and metadata preflight
explicitly authorized release-scoped predicate and column-pushdown extraction
local privacy-minimized processing of U.S. place records
retention of GERS and source-record identifiers for provenance
ZIP/ZCTA coverage analysis and address coordinate linkage
derived source-linked physical-site, establishment, brand, status, taxonomy, and address assertions
redistribution consistent with each contributing source license and required attribution or NOTICE
prohibited_use: initiating the large remote extraction without explicit operator authorization
representing the places theme as a complete census of U.S. businesses
representing Overture confidence as a calibrated probability or completeness score
representing an open operating_status as proof of current hours, legal status, solvency, or continuous operation
representing every place as a commercial business
publishing emails, phone numbers, social profiles, or other excluded contact fields
storing geometry or polygons on business/place entities; retain only address latitude and longitude
joining ZIP5 and ZIP+4 into one canonical postal field
inferring ownership, parent company, network affiliation, or cross-source identity without versioned evidence
attribution: Source: Overture Maps Foundation Places theme. Preserve source-specific attribution and Foursquare Apache-2.0 NOTICE requirements described by Overture.
retention: Retain immutable pinned metadata, privacy-minimized selected source snapshots, and governed normalized releases. Do not retain the global GeoParquet assets.
redistribution: Record-level redistribution must preserve the source-level license and attribution/NOTICE obligations. This connector defaults normalized records to local-review-only and exposes only governed aggregates for general publication.
personal_data_handling: Overture states that Places excludes PII. This connector additionally excludes emails, phones, and social URLs and retains only selected place, taxonomy, source, website, address, and latitude/longitude fields.
